$comment: SEED TEMPLATE for the event_types table (see supabase/migrations/006_event_types.sql and docs/event-type-presets.md). Presets are database-backed and user-managed since migration 006; clients seed a NEW business's event_types rows from this file at business creation (existing businesses were seeded by the migration itself, in English). `key` is stored in bookings.event_type for pre-006 bookings; `emoji` is the default bookings.event_icon; `label_key` resolves the localized display name from the string catalog (used for seeding and for rendering old bookings recorded with a built-in key); `color` is the type's DEFAULT calendar color — a key from booking-colors.json. Color resolution contract (both apps): explicit bookings.color if set → event-type default → standard themed purple. The `custom` type additionally lets the user enter a free-text label and pick any emoji. Emoji are NOT localized. `kind` maps to event_types.kind: 'booking' = real customer booking; 'marker' = auspicious-day self-indicator (Lagan, Tilak) — calendar highlight only, no customer or payments, excluded from booking counts and revenue.
